resources.string: Save a portable, passphrase-protected copy of your notes, images, and tag customization. Restore adds missing notes and keeps existing notes unchanged.
Use a passphrase of 12–1,024 characters. Keep it somewhere safe: a forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered. Your passphrase is not saved.
Enter the original backup passphrase. Existing note IDs are skipped; existing tag customization is kept. Device security settings are not restored.
Could not unlock this backup. Check the passphrase and file, or cancel and choose the file again. Existing notes are unchanged.
Restoring missing notes. Existing notes are kept unchanged.
Restored notes: %1$d. Existing note IDs skipped: %2$d. Existing notes were kept unchanged.

Could not restore the backup. It may be unsupported, damaged, too large, or contain conflicting image identities. Check available storage and choose the file again. Existing notes were kept unchanged.
